objective: Correct Part 4 so Custom Prompt is the selectable prompt-construction profile while plugins/capabilities remain separate, and add impact-aware release closure that avoids unnecessary broad persistence for small patches.

constraints.text: Profiles define reusable behavior; Deep Research/web/files/connectors are separately enabled capabilities and must not be silently activated.
Minor-patch optimization must preserve correctness, provenance, rollback and one complete regression before commit.
constraints.provenance: explicit user request plus existing closure invariants

constraints.text: The Windows working tree resides inside OneDrive and should be treated as one edit target with passive sync, not two manual persistence transactions.

claims.text: The v0.21 Deep Research Agent Architect profile was the wrong abstraction for the requested design.
claims.provenance: user correction and v0.21 runtime comparison

claims.text: A deterministic impact classifier can safely reduce unrelated derived regeneration when changes are bounded and independently verifiable.
This v0.22 mutation itself requires MAJOR_PATCH closure because it changes the schema and persistence/orchestration lifecycle.

evidence.source: pdf_engine/tests full regression suite: 58 tests passed
workspace_ctl.py impact -> MAJOR_PATCH for v0.22 implementation
pdf_system_engine.py full closure -> stable fixed point in 2 passes; generated=2; major persistent workspace closure PASS
Visual inspection of all rendered Formats.pdf and PDF_Workflow.pdf pages after v0.22 generation

assumptions.text: OneDrive continues to sync the configured local working tree normally; passive sync status is not used as a substitute for Git history.

alternatives.option: Keep deep_research_agent_architect as a profile and only rename it.
alternatives.reason: Still conflates a capability-oriented use case with the requested reusable Custom Prompt profile.
Useful research-prompt architecture belongs inside Custom Prompt without becoming a separate profile.

alternatives.option: Always perform full closure for every mutation.
alternatives.reason: Preserves correctness but wastes time on unrelated derived artifacts for bounded changes.
Provides cheap bounded closure when safe while retaining automatic major closure for broad/core changes.

decision: Adopt custom_prompt as the canonical CREATE profile with prompt_creator as an alias; keep plugin/capability activation separate; remove the Deep Research profile/automatic precursor; add executable MINOR_PATCH/MAJOR_PATCH classification and single OneDrive-backed working-tree plus Git persistence.

unknowns.text: Actual wall-clock savings for future minor patches are not yet measured and must not be claimed until observed.
unknowns.provenance: no post-v0.22 minor-patch production sample yet

verification.check: Semantic fixed point reached in 2 passes
Formats.pdf visual inspection clean across rendered pages
PDF_Workflow.pdf visual inspection clean across rendered pages
